chat_subtitle: You are talking to a specialized AI Bot Support.

questions.q: How do I create a product?
questions.a: Open Products from the sidebar, click 'New product', enter name, code, unit, reference price, category and save.
Categories organize products and limit which items appear while building a quote.

questions.q: Can I use products without a category?
questions.a: No. Every product used in a quote must belong to a category.

questions.q: How do I create a quote?
questions.a: Open Quotes, click 'New quote' and add products with quantities and prices. Use the category filter if you want to narrow the product list.

questions.q: How do I send the quote to the client?
questions.a: After saving, click 'Share' to copy the form link or the ready message. Delivery is manual through the channel you prefer.
No. The platform generates the quote, link and ready message; the user shares it manually.
Categories group products and help build quotes with coherent items.

questions.q: How do I create a category?
questions.a: Open Categories from the sidebar, click 'New category', enter the name and save.
Yes. Use the search field on the Categories screen to search by name or description.

questions.q: Where can I see my plan?
questions.a: Open Subscription from the sidebar to see plan, status, current cycle, and supplier responses received.

questions.q: Which plan do I get when creating an account?
questions.a: Every account starts on the Free plan, with 15 supplier responses per month, basic platform access, and no included support.
Plan switching is handled on the subscription page, with card payments.

questions.q: The page did not refresh after saving
questions.a: Refresh the page or try opening the module again from the sidebar.
Refresh the page (F5) or clear the browser cache. It works best in Chrome/Firefox.

questions.q: My verification email did not arrive
questions.a: Check spam/junk. Request a new send from Settings > Resend Email.
